story.fullStory:
Pure Prairie League's "Amie" reached #27 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Amie" is a song by the American country rock group Pure Prairie League.

The song initially appeared on the band's 1972 album, Bustin' Out.

It was subsequently released as a single in 1975, after it gained popularity as an album cut.

The song peaked at #27 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 13 weeks on the chart.
